preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is an integer between 1 and 1000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(len(s) >= 2 and len(s) <= 50 for s in test_cases)
preconditions.description: Each test case string s has length n where 2 ≤ n ≤ 50.

preconditions.expression: all(all(c in {'E', 'N'} for c in s) for s in test_cases)
preconditions.description: Each character in s is either 'E' (equal) or 'N' (not equal).

postconditions.expression: all(output_line == 'YES' or output_line == 'NO' for output_line in output_lines)
postconditions.description: Each output line is either 'YES' or 'NO'.
The number of output lines matches the number of test cases.

postconditions.expression: all((output_lines[i] == 'YES') == is_consistent(test_cases[i]) for i in range(len(test_cases)))
postconditions.description: For each test case, 'YES' is printed if and only if there exists an array a consistent with the equality/non-equality constraints in s.
